name: build
_: Linear graph with a verifier gate inside the build node (loop) and a cross-review node (graph). Author never reviews itself.

nodes.prompt:
Write a tight implementation spec for this task. No code.

TASK:
{input}

Output: goal in one sentence; files to touch; the smallest design that works; explicit non-goals; 3-6 acceptance criteria that a skeptic could check against the actual diff.

criteria: Every acceptance criterion in the spec is actually met by the code on disk
No stubs, TODOs, or placeholder returns on the happy path
Errors and edge cases at trust boundaries are handled
Nothing outside the spec's scope was changed
